title: Hard Graft
label: Contagious Recordings
format: 12" vinyl, 45 rpm, white label with sticker

type.basis: Evidence specimen. No published description of its sound was found, so every character is drafted.

context.text: Plastician called it his third release, from about 2002–03, and opened his 2004 Red Bull Music Academy lecture with it.
Wikipedia says that by 2003 DJ Hatcha was supporting Plasticman tracks such as 'Hard Graft'.
A commenter on k-punk's 2004 post called 'Hard Graft' the best track they had heard in ages (reader comment, not the author).

rels.other: Hard Graft (Mark One Remix), on the B-side of the same 12"

uncertainty: Label conflict: the dealer listing (which cites Discogs release r22630064) says Contagious Recordings, CONTAGIOUS-004, April 2003. Wikipedia instead ties 'Hard Graft' to 2003 releases on Soulja and ROAD, Ammunition Promotions imprints. Contagious may be a third imprint, or there may be more than one pressing; this is unresolved. RBMA credits the track as 'Mark One vs. Plasticman'. No published description of the sound was found. Note: the 'Industrial Graft' on the Rephlex 'Grime' comp is a different title and was not assumed to be the same track.
tracklist: A: Plasticman – Hard Graft (5:05); B: Hard Graft (Mark One Remix) (4:26).
